title: AI Developer

Create solutions for processing documents, finding information, summarizing text, and organizing data. Set up API connections, automate workflows, and link AI agents with current software. You are familiar with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, and connecting knowledge bases. You have experience connecting AI solutions with CRMs, databases, and business applications. You have strong problem-solving skills. You can turn business needs into working technical solutions. You have excellent communication skills. You can work well on your own.Preferred Skills You have experience working with law firms, legal technology, or legal AI.
